title: Ask directly above your avatar
description: Type requests or start talking from an avatar’s overhead bubble in solo and Together. Task updates and follow-up questions stay with the addressed character, while the rest of the desktop remains clickable.
highlights: Right-click Ask [name] to do something to open a compact overhead input with examples and a microphone.
Double-click a character’s head to start talking. Together keeps requests and updates attached to the selected character.
Agent questions appear inside the same bubble; no full-screen request dialog blocks the desktop.
Task progress is tracked independently for group members, with shared group context for typed requests.
New agent tasks start in Downloads by default; home paths are displayed as ~ in settings and task updates.
Includes the v0.2.13 visual, wardrobe, motion and deep-zoom improvements with the existing protected avatar downloads.
